description: All you need to create two uniquely designed snow globes. Set includes 2 snow globes with 2 fridge magnets, 6 colouring cards, 6 assorted felt tips and 112 stickers. Free-standing or use the magnetic reverse to showcase on your fridge. Reuse year after year. H5 x W7 x D3cm. Paper & plastic. Suitable for ages 3+ years.
